step1_drop_outlier_episodes.justification: episode contains a joint-state value |z|>6 vs. that joint's own global distribution (real finding from Task 1, episode 8, 56 frames) - physically implausible values are almost never recoverable per-frame, drop the whole recording session

step2_smoothing.justification: reduces high-frequency encoder/logging jitter in state/action without distorting the low-frequency task trajectory shape (polyorder=2 preserves smooth accel/decel)

egocentric_extension.method: per-frame validity mask (blurred OR overexposed) from egocentric_audit.py, joined on (episode_index, frame_index) rather than deleting video frames, so alignment with the (filtered, smoothed) teleop table is never broken
